skill.description: Creates SEO-focused page plans, page copy, keyword maps, schema guidance, and validation workflows for local service sites and content teams.

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, Schema.org examples, analytics snippets, and SEO template text. Confirmed risks remain in optional scripts that write files and perform live URL crawling or PageSpeed API requests. The skill should require clear user consent before running scripts and should constrain generated output paths.

remediation.issue: Batch generation writes to paths supplied by the configuration file.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize each output path, reject absolute paths and parent-directory traversal, and force writes under the chosen output directory.

remediation.issue: The SEO auditor crawls live user-supplied URLs and calls external services.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before network audits, document the destination services, add rate limits, and support a domain allowlist.

remediation.issue: Report and page generation can overwrite existing files.
remediation.suggestion: Add a dry-run mode, warn before overwriting files, and create backups or require a force flag for replacement writes.

remediation.issue: Analytics examples include third-party Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics snippets.
remediation.suggestion: Document privacy implications and require users to supply their own public analytics IDs before enabling these snippets.

semantic_findings.title: Unrestricted Batch Output File Paths
semantic_findings.description: The batch generator accepts an output path from each page configuration and writes generated content there without constraining it to the selected output directory. A malicious or mistaken config can overwrite files the process can access.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code takes page_config output values and passes them directly to directory creation and file write calls. This is a concrete path control issue, not just a generic filesystem warning.

semantic_findings.title: Live URL Crawler Can Probe User-Supplied Targets
semantic_findings.description: The SEO auditor crawls a user-provided URL, follows same-target links, checks robots.txt and sitemap.xml, and can call PageSpeed Insights. This is legitimate SEO functionality, but it can be misused for network probing from the runtime environment.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The crawler and network requests are explicit in the code and operate on user-supplied targets. The intent is SEO auditing, so the severity is medium rather than critical.

content.value_statement: Local SEO teams need many optimized pages without losing structure or consistency. This skill provides keyword maps, templates, schema examples, and validation workflows for repeatable content production.
actual_capabilities: Maps high-intent SEO keywords by service, location, problem, authority, and conversion intent.
Provides reusable page templates for homepages, service pages, blog posts, and local landing pages.
Generates batch page drafts from structured configuration through the included Python generator.
Validates titles, descriptions, headings, word count, links, images, and FAQ coverage.
Supplies Schema.org examples for medical, course, FAQ, breadcrumb, and organization pages.
Documents an Astro-based SEO stack with sitemap, analytics, metadata, and schema components.
limitations: It does not guarantee search rankings, traffic, leads, or indexing speed.
Generated medical, legal, or regulated claims require expert review before publication.
Included scripts can write files or request live URLs when a user runs them.
The templates require accurate brand facts, locations, offers, and approved source material.

use_cases.title: Build Local Service Pages
use_cases.description: Create consistent service and location pages with mapped keywords, metadata, FAQ sections, and internal link targets.

use_cases.title: Scale Agency Content Production
use_cases.description: Turn a keyword plan and content brief into repeatable page outlines, copy blocks, and validation checklists.

use_cases.title: Audit Technical SEO Readiness
use_cases.description: Check generated pages for titles, descriptions, headings, schema presence, link counts, image alt text, and content length.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Service Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a service page outline for [service] in [city]. Include title, description, H1, H2 sections, FAQ topics, and internal links.

prompt_templates.title: Map Local SEO Keywords
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a keyword map for [business type]. Group terms by service, location, problem, authority, and conversion intent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Batch Content Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare briefs for [number] SEO pages using these services and locations: [list]. Include unique angles, metadata, FAQs, and CTAs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Improve a Page Set
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these page drafts against the skill checklist. Identify gaps in metadata, headings, schema, internal links, image alt text, and claims.

output_examples.input: Create an SEO page plan for a dental implant clinic in Phoenix.
output: Suggested title: Dental Implants Phoenix | Durable Tooth Replacement.
Sections: consultation process, treatment steps, candidate criteria, recovery, cost factors, FAQ, and appointment CTA.

output_examples.input: Audit a draft blog post about facial anatomy for SEO readiness.
output: The title is within the target length, but the description is too short.
The page needs one clear H1, at least five internal links, and a stronger FAQ section.
Medical claims should cite approved source material before publication.

output_examples.input: Plan multilingual pages for a professional training course.
output: Create separate briefs for Portuguese, English, and Spanish pages.
Adapt examples, CTAs, and questions for each audience instead of translating word for word.
Add hreflang guidance and local terminology for each language.

best_practices: Provide approved facts, claims, locations, offers, and source material before asking for final copy.
Review every regulated claim with a qualified expert before publishing medical or legal content.
Run validation scripts on a copy of the project and review file changes before committing.
anti_patterns: Do not publish generated claims without verifying evidence, permissions, and local advertising rules.
Do not reuse one page with only city names changed across many locations.
Do not run the included crawler against sites you do not own or have permission to test.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates SEO content plans, page templates, keyword maps, schema guidance, and validation workflows.

faq.question: Can it guarantee Google rankings?
faq.answer: No. It supports structured SEO work, but rankings depend on competition, authority, quality, technical health, and search changes.

faq.question: Does it support local SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on service, location, problem, authority, and conversion keywords for local and professional service pages.

faq.question: Can it create multilingual content?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for Portuguese, English, and Spanish content with hreflang and localization considerations.

faq.question: Are the included scripts required?
faq.answer: No. They are optional helpers for batch generation, page validation, and SEO audits.

faq.question: What should users review before publishing?
faq.answer: Users should review claims, compliance, citations, uniqueness, internal links, schema validity, and all generated file changes.
